_comment: VECTOR's voices, all local. engine qwen speaks each role from its reference (rendered once by voices/make-refs.py from the operator's own Brodec cast voices on Fish, stored in ~/.local/share/bromigos/voices, never committed; no Fish calls at runtime); kokoro is the fallback. A role's 'use' text is what the brain is told about when to switch to it, so changing a role's job (e.g. floor -> lore and recaps) is just editing 'use'. shimmer: projector DSP per role, 0 = dry, 1 = very machine. colour: the hologram's tint while that voice speaks. mode: auto (VECTOR picks) unless `bromigos-holo voice <role>` pins one.

robot.name: sigil
robot.use: machine readouts: status reports, lists of numbers, diagnostics, 'running scan' lines, anything said as a system

scientist.name: professor_arc
scientist.use: technology specifically: how something works, a clever mechanism, new tech, a discovery or a cool result

floor.name: revolver_lynx
floor.use: ARBITER and the Floor: markets, trades, positions, P&L, the referee and the lineup

notify.name: lin_yao
notify.use: notifications and codec calls (chosen by the desktop, never by the brain)

designed_fallback.text: Hello, and welcome. I am the caretaker, and everything here is running exactly as it should. Protocol is wise, and I am simply delighted to see you.

stt.prompt: VECTOR, the Wick, ARBITER, the rack room, Argo CD, Prometheus, EchoCraft Lab, vLLM, Qwen, crackle, pop, snap.

breeze.instruction: An older English gentleman with a bright, prim, precise voice and crisp diction; chipper, sing-song and delighted, with quiet ancient authority, like a very polite caretaker who loves his job.
